response.summary: Overall quality is mixed: the notebook runs end-to-end and reports metrics consistently, but it has a serious evaluation flaw. The most important issue is data leakage: the feature scaling is fit on the full dataset before the train/test split, which makes the reported test performance unreliable and suggests a gap in basic ML methodology. A second concern is that the conclusion relies on accuracy despite a highly imbalanced churn rate and very low churn recall, meaning the model would miss most customers who actually churn. In interview, ask her to explain how to structure preprocessing with a Pipeline (fit on training only), how she would evaluate an imbalanced churn model (recall/precision, PR-AUC, thresholding), and what changes she would make before calling a model “production-ready.”
